raw_graphql_pull_request.body:
## Motivation

radixark/miles#4325 added six tests to the miles `nightly-stage-c-8-gpu-mi350` suite, raising its estimated time from 16600s to 23600s. Since then the single 8-GPU job in both miles nightlies runs into the step timeout:

- MI35X: `The action 'Run miles CI suite nightly-stage-c-8-gpu-mi350' has timed out after 180 minutes` on 10-25 and 10-26 ([10-26 run](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/actions/runs/40370401626)). Before the new tests landed it passed in ~150 min.
- MI30X: timed out after 300 minutes on 10-25 and 10-26 ([10-26 run](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/actions/runs/40401635417)).

## Modifications

Split the 8-GPU suite into two jobs with `run_suite.py --auto-partition-id/--auto-partition-size`, the same way the MI35X 4-GPU suite is already split. Applied to both `nightly-test-amd-miles-rocm10.yml` (MI35X) and `nightly-test-amd-miles-rocm10-mi30x.yml` (MI30X).

The MI30X job also gets the same `name:` template as the MI35X one, so the parts show up as `part 1/2` / `part 2/2` instead of a list of every matrix value.

With the estimates in miles main, the split is 11700s / 11900s. No single test hangs: on 10-26 the MI35X job finished 18 of 25 tests normally and was killed partway through the 19th. With the per-test times from that run (and 10-24 for the last seven), the two halves come to about 129 and 97 min of test time on MI35X, against the 180-min timeout.

## Test plan

- [x] MI35X dispatch on this branch: https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/actions/runs/40457823083. Both 8-GPU halves pass: [part 1/2](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/actions/runs/40457823083/job/122035170317) in 126 min, [part 2/2](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/actions/runs/40457823083/job/122035170329) in 97 min.
- [x] MI30X dispatch on this branch: https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/actions/runs/40457826240. Both 8-GPU halves finish within the 300-min timeout: [part 1/2](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/actions/runs/40457826240/job/122035180208) in 190 min, [part 2/2](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/actions/runs/40457826240/job/122035179927) in 154 min. The jobs are still red because of five test failures that also fail on main's 10-26 MI30X run: three per-test timeouts (`test_deepseek_v4_1_4layer_ci`, `test_nospec_r3_bf16_sgl_dpattn1x4_meg_tp1cp1_fullyasync`, `test_qwen3_5_35b_a3b_lora_native_ci`), `test_spec_mtptrain_nor3_fp8_sgl_tp2_meg_tp1cp1_fullyasync` (400 from `update_weights_from_distributed`) and `test_qwen3_8_next_4layer_ci`. Those are separate from this change.

<!-- pr-states:start -->
---
### CI States

Latest PR Test (Base): <!-- slot:pr-test:start -->:white_check_mark: [Run #40457890031](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/actions/runs/40457890031)<!-- slot:pr-test:end -->
Latest PR Test (Extra): <!-- slot:pr-test-extra:start -->:x: [Run #40457889975](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/actions/runs/40457889975)<!-- slot:pr-test-extra:end -->
Latest PR Test (AMD ROCm 10): <!-- slot:pr-test-amd:start -->:heavy_minus_sign: **No AMD PR run found for this commit**.<!-- slot:pr-test-amd:end -->
<!-- pr-states:end -->

files.patch:
@@ -25,6 +25,7 @@ concurrency:
 jobs:
   test-miles-mi30x:
     if: github.repository == 'sgl-project/sglang'
+    name: test-miles-mi30x (${{ matrix.suite }}, ${{ matrix.runner }}${{ matrix.partition_size && format(', part {0}', matrix.part) || '' }})
     strategy:
       fail-fast: false
       matrix:
@@ -41,15 +42,26 @@ jobs:
             skip_tests: >-
               tests/e2e/sglang/test_session_server_multi_role/test_qwen38small.py
               tests/e2e/megatron/model_scripts/test_glm5_2_744b_a40b_5layer_ci.py
-          # The 4- and 8-GPU suites run past 180 min on MI300X; they take ~155 and ~112 min on MI355X.
+          # The 4- and 8-GPU suites run past 180 min on MI300X; the 4-GPU suite takes ~155 min on MI355X.
           - suite: nightly-stage-c-4-gpu-mi350
             runner: linux-mi300-4gpu-sglang
             timeout: 300
             skip_tests: ""
+          # The 8-GPU suite no longer finishes in 300 min on MI300X; split it in two.
           - suite: nightly-stage-c-8-gpu-mi350
             runner: linux-mi300-8gpu-sglang
             timeout: 300
             skip_tests: ""
+            partition_id: 0
+            partition_size: 2
+            part: 1/2
+          - suite: nightly-stage-c-8-gpu-mi350
+            runner: linux-mi300-8gpu-sglang
+            timeout: 300
+            skip_tests: ""
+            partition_id: 1
+            partition_size: 2
+            part: 2/2
     runs-on: ${{ matrix.runner }}
     steps:
       - name: Checkout code
@@ -107,6 +119,7 @@ jobs:
             -e PYTHONPATH=/root/miles:/opt/tilelang \
             -e GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY=/sglang-checkout/github_summary.md \
             python3 tests/ci/run_suite.py --hw rocm --suite ${{ matrix.suite }} --cadence nightly \
+            ${{ matrix.partition_size && format('--auto-partition-id {0} --auto-partition-size {1}', matrix.partition_id, matrix.partition_size) || '' }} \
             ${{ (github.event_name != 'workflow_dispatch' || inputs.continue_on_error) && '--continue-on-error' || '' }} || TEST_EXIT_CODE=$?
           cat "${GITHUB_WORKSPACE}/github_summary.md" >> "$GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY" || true
           exit ${TEST_EXIT_CODE}

@@ -46,8 +46,18 @@ jobs:
             partition_id: 1
             partition_size: 2
             part: 2/2
+          # The 8-GPU suite grew to ~6.5 h of estimated test time and no longer
+          # finishes in the step timeout; split it the same way.
           - suite: nightly-stage-c-8-gpu-mi350
             runner: linux-mi35x-gpu-8
+            partition_id: 0
+            partition_size: 2
+            part: 1/2
+          - suite: nightly-stage-c-8-gpu-mi350
+            runner: linux-mi35x-gpu-8
+            partition_id: 1
+            partition_size: 2
+            part: 2/2
     runs-on: ${{ matrix.runner }}
     steps:
       - name: Checkout code
